_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the send button" is [data-testid="send-button"]; "queued badges" are [data-testid="queued-badge"]. "Send X and wait for work" means: fill the input with X, click the send button, and wait (up to 30s) for the thinking indicator [data-testid="agent-thinking"] to be visible. Keys pressed "in the input" go to the input while it has focus (filling it focuses it). "Press M+Enter" presses its modifiers as a keyboard does: a key_down step for each modifier M in the order written, then a press_key step "Enter" (without modifiers of its own; the held keys apply), then a key_up step for each modifier in reverse order. Every test starts: navigate to /c/queue-shortcut and wait (up to 30s) for the input to be visible. Alt+Enter keeps a pending upload in the composer and queues it once it is ready. Uploads (/api/upload) are held back until call "release upload", and then answered with the path "/tmp/queue-shortcut.txt". window.setInputFiles(selector, files) chooses files in a file input, as a user picking them would: call it in an eval, e.g. window.setInputFiles('input[type="file"]', [["a.txt", "content"]]). Call "queued chat" describes the first /chat request whose JSON body has queue true: "none" before there is one, else whether its message mentions the uploaded file's path ("with attachment" or "without attachment"). 1. Navigate to /c/queue-shortcut and wait for the input. 2. Send "delay: 60" and wait for work, then for the input's value to be exactly "" (the send has gone through: files chosen while it is in flight are cleared with it). 3. Eval window.setInputFiles('input[type="file"]', [["queue-shortcut.txt", "queued attachment"]]). 4. There should be exactly one ".message-attachment-uploading". 5. Fill the input with "keep my attachment" and press Alt+Enter in it. 6. The input's value should still be exactly "keep my attachment", there should still be exactly one ".message-attachment-uploading", and there must be no queued badge (count 0). 7. Call "release upload". 8. There should be exactly one ".message-attachment-ready". 9. Call "queued chat"; it must be "none". 10. Press Alt+Enter in the input again. 11. Call "queued chat"; it should become exactly "with attachment". 12. The input's value should become exactly "", there should be no ".message-attachment" at all (count 0), and there should be exactly one queued badge.
